podcast.title: Sonic Proximity to Witchhouse
podcast.body: Synthwave was a genre whose synthesizer sounds were often very close to those used in Witchhouse, and it was also beginning to emerge and gain prominence around the same years as Witchhouse. "capas denares de sintetizadores, en ocasiones muy cercanas al simway, otro genero que también estaba empezando despuntar por aquellos años."
